jobs.crash_recovery: delete only unpublished temp artifact owned by job, then restart writing; if atomically published and verified, reconcile bounded export evidence without rewriting artifact
jobs.cancellation: allowed before atomic publish; after publish job completes evidence reconciliation
jobs.coalescing: none; each explicit export request is independent

jobs.crash_recovery: unpublished current-file staging is discarded/reparsed only after stabilized file identity still matches; published runs are idempotently skipped
jobs.cancellation: allowed between file checkpoints; never leaves a validating run published as reviewable
jobs.sensitive_field_policy: no secrets/full workbook XML/unbounded cell bodies in payload/checkpoint
jobs.coalescing: at most one active Check-now job for the same setting_revision; a duplicate command reuses prior job through COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1

writer_lock_rule: No job holds SQLite writer transaction while enumerating directories, parsing XLSX, hashing, writing or verifying artifact files.
